title: Learning When to Translate for Multilingual Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2606.02465v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Reasoning language models (RLMs) achieve strong performance on complex reasoning tasks, but still exhibit substantial multilingual reasoning gaps, largely due to language-understanding failures when interpreting non-English inputs. Translation into English can mitigate these failures by expressing non-English inputs in a form that RLMs can more reliably interpret, yet translating every input incurs unnecessary inference cost when the model can reason reliably from the original query. To address this challenge, we propose Luar, a Language Understanding Boundary-aware Reinforcement Learning framework that trains RLMs to selectively invoke translation when their direct understanding is unreliable. Luar trains the model to either solve the original input directly or reason over its English translation, encouraging translation only when translator-augmented reasoning is expected to substantially outperform direct reasoning. translated_title: 学习何时翻译以实现多语言推理
translated_abstract: 推理语言模型在复杂推理任务上表现优异，但在多语言推理方面仍存在显著差距，这主要源于模型在理解非英语输入时的语言理解失败。将输入翻译成英语可以通过以模型能够更可靠解释的形式表达非英语输入来缓解这些失败，然而当模型能够直接从原始查询可靠地进行推理时，对每个输入都进行翻译会产生不必要的推理成本。为应对这一挑战，我们提出Luar，一个语言理解边界感知的强化学习框架，训练推理语言模型在其直接理解不可靠时选择性地调用翻译。Luar训练模型要么直接解决原始输入，要么对其英文翻译进行推理，仅当翻译增强的推理预期显著优于直接推理时才鼓励使用翻译。
tldr: 提出Luar框架，通过语言理解边界感知的强化学习，训练推理语言模型仅在对非英语输入直接理解不可靠时才调用翻译，从而在提升多语言推理性能的同时避免不必要的推理成本。
en_tdlr: Luar, a language understanding boundary-aware reinforcement learning framework, trains reasoning language models to selectively invoke translation only when their direct understanding of non-English inputs is unreliable, improving multilingual reasoning while avoiding unnecessary inference costs.
